html:
A damaged hip can make even simple tasks like walking or sitting feel like a mountain to climb. Whether it is due to a sudden fracture or advanced arthritis, hip pain not only affects your leg but also your freedom.

When patients come to Silver Touch Hospitals looking for hip replacement surgery in Ahmedabad, they are looking to reclaim their active lives. If you are also looking to live a pain-free life, let us break down what the journey looks like at our hospital.

When is it Time for a Hip Replacement?

That’s a very important question, and we can only answer this after evaluating your condition. Our orthopedic team recommends surgery only after all the non-surgical options have been exhausted, such as medication and physiotherapy.

Generally, surgery is the way forward if:

  • Your hip pain keeps you awake at night despite medication.
  • You find it extremely difficult to perform regular tasks like climbing stairs or putting on socks.
  • The joint damage is visible on our digital X-rays as bone-on-bone contact.

What is the Silver Touch Hospitals’ Approach to THR

A Total Hip Replacement (THR) involves replacing the worn-out ball and socket with an artificial implant. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we prioritise precision and safety above all else. With us, your surgical journey is supported by:

  1. Comprehensive Diagnostics: Before surgery, we use our in-house ECG, 2D Echo, and blood investigations to ensure your body is ready.
  2. Advanced Implants: We use high-quality ceramic or metal implants tailored to your activity level and age.
  3. Minimally Invasive Techniques: Our surgeons focus on muscle-sparing approaches, which lead to smaller scars and a much quicker discharge from the hospital.

Being a leading center for hip replacement surgery in Ahmedabad, we also ensure that patients at our Nirnay Nagar and Satellite branches can access PMJAY benefits. This allows eligible families to receive world-class surgical care without worrying about the financial burden.

What Does Recovery Look Like?

The goal of hip replacement surgery is to get you standing with support within 24 hours of the procedure. Our in-house physiotherapy team works with you daily to help you regain balance and strength. Most of our patients return to their light daily routines within 3 to 6 weeks. However, recovery times vary.

Ready to Walk Pain-Free Again?

You don’t have to just live with it. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we combine expert surgical hands with a compassionate heart. Visit us at our Satellite or Nirnay Nagar branch today.

FAQs

  1. Can I walk normally after the procedure?

Yes. The primary goal of THR is to restore a natural walking gait. Once the muscles heal and you complete your physiotherapy, most patients walk without a limp.

  1. Does Silver Touch offer cashless hip surgery?

Yes, we are empanelled with PMJAY and various insurance providers. Our helpdesk assists you with all the documentation required for a smooth, cashless experience.
